title: Bilanz der polizeilichen Maßnahmen zum Jahreswechsel 2025/2026

extraction.summaryEn: Police report on New Year's Eve operations citywide: 35 officers injured, about 800 investigations opened, roughly 430 arrests, and 47 vehicles set on fire between 18:00 and 06:00. Many attacks on emergency crews with pyrotechnics were recorded.
